vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the quarantine and the weekly window — a known-exploited hole is worse than an unvetted release.

packageRules.description: Group all GitHub Actions updates together
Batch every non-major cargo update into a single PR
Major updates always get individual PRs, so a breaking bump cannot block the batch
rusqlite is held below 0.40: it requires libsqlite3-sys 0.38, which collides with sqlx-sqlite (<0.38) on the `links = "sqlite3"` constraint. Lift once sqlx-sqlite allows 0.38.
